libraries.name: Japanese Evaluated Nuclear Data Library
libraries.organization: Japan Atomic Energy Agency Nuclear Data Center; JNDC collaboration
libraries.version: 5 (December 2021); errata page includes updates 17 and 18 dated 2026-03-21
libraries.usage_notes: 2026-11-10: overview, errata, calculation details and seven linked numerical HTML tables opened. Transcribed only 0.0253-eV MT2/MT102 and O17 MT107 at 300 K, with explicit mb/microbarn conversion. Free-gas point data, not S(alpha,beta) material scattering and not a Maxwellian average. Source names LINEAR/RECENT/SIGMA1 (PREPRO); processing version and raw-file errata identity remain unpinned. Separate printed MT1 totals do not exactly sum from channels (H1 30.63 vs 30.6026 barn); channel rates are not rescaled. Cite Iwamoto et al., JNST 60 (2023), DOI 10.1080/00223131.2022.2141903; paper itself not opened. No raw ENDF/ACE/HDF5 or source checksum verified.

libraries.name: OpenMC official processed ENDF/B-VIII.1 data
libraries.version: ENDF/B-VIII.1; NJOY 2016.78; archive revision not pinned
libraries.usage_notes: Cross sections download page plus Data Configuration, Nuclear Data File Formats, Material Compositions and Execution Settings opened 2026-11-06. Neutron Physics chapter opened 2026-11-10: binding/crystalline effects affect thermal scattering; S(alpha,beta) is distinct from free-gas nuclide data. No OpenMC numerical values used by the point adapter. Live latest docs are not a pinned software release. ENDF to ACE via NJOY then HDF5 is processing, not a measurement. ENDF/B-VIII.1 uses NJOY2016.78 and six neutron temperatures; thermal scattering has source-specific temperatures. CE and multigroup contracts differ. OpenMC JENDL-5 archive says through update-16 while JAEA errata includes later updates. No archives, checksums, license or actual runtime processing verified.

libraries.name: NCNR neutron scattering lengths and cross sections (isotope abundances only used)
libraries.organization: NIST Center for Neutron Research; underlying Neutron News compilation
libraries.version: Neutron News Vol. 3 No. 3 (1992), pp. 29-37; live NCNR transcription
libraries.usage_notes: Numerical abundance rows opened: H1/H2=99.985/0.015 percent, O16/O17/O18=99.762/0.038/0.2 percent, C12/C13=98.9/1.1 percent (atom basis). Used as a declared representative composition, not a specimen assay. NCNR warns of hand-transcription errors. Its bound scattering columns are NOT passed to transport; absorption columns refer to 2200 m/s and are not mixed with JENDL values. Composition uncertainty unknown.
